import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


# Version parsing and validation

class TestVersionValidation:
    """Test valid and invalid version formats."""

    def test_valid_simple_versions(self):
        """Test valid simple semantic versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("10.20.30", "10.20.30")

    def test_leading_v_allowed(self):
        """Test that leading 'v' is allowed and ignored."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_whitespace_handling(self):
        """Test that surrounding whitespace is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  1.2.3  ")
        assert satisfies("  v1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_versions(self):
        """Test versions with prerelease tags."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-0", "1.2.3-0")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-x.7.z.92", "1.2.3-x.7.z.92")

    def test_build_metadata(self):
        """Test that build metadata is allowed and ignored."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3+build")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build1", "1.2.3+build2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha+build", "1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_invalid_version_no_patch(self):
        """Partial versions without operator should raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros_major(self):
        """Leading zeros in major version are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros_minor(self):
        """Leading zeros in minor version are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros_patch(self):
        """Leading zeros in patch version are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros_prerelease(self):
        """Leading zeros in numeric prerelease identifiers are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_empty_prerelease(self):
        """Empty prerelease tag is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_too_many_parts(self):
        """Version with extra parts is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric_major(self):
        """Non-numeric major version is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.2.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric_minor(self):
        """Non-numeric minor version is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.b.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric_patch(self):
        """Non-numeric patch version is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.c", "*")


# Version comparison

class TestVersionComparison:
    """Test version ordering and comparison."""

    def test_numeric_comparison_major(self):
        """Test numeric comparison by major version."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">2.0.0")

    def test_numeric_comparison_minor(self):
        """Test numeric comparison by minor version when major is equal."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.1.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", ">1.2.0")

    def test_numeric_comparison_patch(self):
        """Test numeric comparison by patch version when major and minor are equal."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.3", ">=1.1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.2", ">1.1.3")

    def test_prerelease_lower_than_release(self):
        """Test that prerelease version is lower than release."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<=1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_numeric(self):
        """Test that numeric prerelease identifiers compare numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-2", ">1.0.0-1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-10", ">1.0.0-9")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_alpha(self):
        """Test that non-numeric prerelease identifiers compare in ASCII order."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-b", "<1.0.0-c")

    def test_prerelease_numeric_vs_alpha(self):
        """Test that numeric identifiers are always lower than non-numeric."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-99", "<1.0.0-a")

    def test_prerelease_fewer_identifiers_lower(self):
        """Test that fewer prerelease identifiers means lower version."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-1.0")

    def test_build_metadata_ignored(self):
        """Test that build metadata is ignored in comparison."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0+build1", ">1.0.0+build2")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0+build1", ">=1.0.0+build2")


# Exact matching

class TestExactMatching:
    """Test exact version matching."""

    def test_exact_match(self):
        """Test exact match operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "=1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")

    def test_exact_mismatch(self):
        """Test exact match mismatch."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3")


# Comparison operators

class TestComparisonOperators:
    """Test basic comparison operators: <, <=, >, >=."""

    def test_greater_than(self):
        """Test greater than operator."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.1", ">1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.0", ">1.0.0")

    def test_greater_than_equal(self):
        """Test greater than or equal operator."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.0", ">=1.0.0")

    def test_less_than(self):
        """Test less than operator."""
        assert satisfies("0.9.0", "<1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<1.0.0")

    def test_less_than_equal(self):
        """Test less than or equal operator."""
        assert satisfies("0.9.0", "<=1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<=1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1.0.0")

    def test_operators_with_whitespace(self):
        """Test operators followed by whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">= 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("0.9.0", "< 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<= 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "> 1.0.0")


# X-ranges and partial versions

class TestXRanges:
    """Test X-ranges and partial versions."""

    def test_wildcard_star(self):
        """Test that * matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "*")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "*")

    def test_wildcard_x(self):
        """Test that x matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "x")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "x")

    def test_wildcard_X(self):
        """Test that X matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "X")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "X")

    def test_empty_range(self):
        """Test that empty range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "")

    def test_partial_major_minor(self):
        """Test partial versions with major.minor."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.100", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.2.0", "1.2")

    def test_partial_major_only(self):
        """Test partial versions with major only."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.100.200", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")

    def test_explicit_x_minor(self):
        """Test explicit x in minor position."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.3", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.100.200", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")

    def test_explicit_X_minor(self):
        """Test explicit X in minor position."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.X")
        assert satisfies("1.5.3", "1.X")

    def test_explicit_x_patch(self):
        """Test explicit x in patch position."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.100", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")

    def test_gt_partial_major_only(self):
        """Test > with partial major version."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1")
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1")

    def test_gt_partial_major_x(self):
        """Test > with major.x pattern."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">1.x")

    def test_gt_partial_major_minor(self):
        """Test > with major.minor pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.4.0", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.5", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", ">1.2")

    def test_gte_partial_major_minor(self):
        """Test >= with major.minor pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">=1.2")

    def test_lt_partial_major_minor(self):
        """Test < with major.minor pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<1.2")

    def test_lte_partial_major_minor(self):
        """Test <= with major.minor pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")

    def test_lte_partial_major_only(self):
        """Test <= with major only."""
        assert satisfies("0.9.9", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "<=1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1")

    def test_gt_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """Test that >* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", ">*")

    def test_lt_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """Test that <* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", "<*")


# Tilde ranges

class TestTildeRanges:
    """Test tilde (~) ranges."""

    def test_tilde_full_version(self):
        """Test tilde with full version allows patch changes."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.100", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1.2.3")

    def test_tilde_major_minor(self):
        """Test tilde with major.minor allows minor changes."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.100.0", "~1.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1.2")

    def test_tilde_major_only(self):
        """Test tilde with major only allows minor and patch changes."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.3", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.100.200", "~1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1")

    def test_tilde_zero_version(self):
        """Test tilde with 0.x.y version."""
        assert satisfies("0.2.3", "~0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.4", "~0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "~0.2.3")

    def test_tilde_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test tilde with prerelease tag."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4-alpha", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3-beta.2")


# Caret ranges

class TestCaretRanges:
    """Test caret (^) ranges."""

    def test_caret_full_version_major_nonzero(self):
        """Test caret with non-zero major version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "^1.2.3")

    def test_caret_zero_minor_nonzero_patch(self):
        """Test caret with 0.x.y version allows changes below minor."""
        assert satisfies("0.2.3", "^0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.4", "^0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "^0.2.3")

    def test_caret_zero_minor_zero_patch(self):
        """Test caret with 0.0.x version allows only patch changes."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.3", "^0.0.3")
        assert satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.3")

    def test_caret_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test caret with prerelease tag."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_caret_zero_prerelease(self):
        """Test caret with 0.0.x prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.3-beta", "^0.0.3-beta")
        assert satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3-beta")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.3-beta")

    def test_caret_partial_major_minor(self):
        """Test caret with major.minor partial version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "^1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2")

    def test_caret_partial_major_x_minor(self):
        """Test caret with major.x pattern."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.x")

    def test_caret_partial_major_only(self):
        """Test caret with major only."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1")

    def test_caret_zero_x_x(self):
        """Test caret with 0.x.x pattern."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.x")
        assert satisfies("0.5.5", "^0.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0.x")

    def test_caret_zero_zero_x(self):
        """Test caret with 0.0.x pattern."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.0.x")
        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.x")

    def test_caret_zero_only(self):
        """Test caret with 0 only."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0")
        assert satisfies("0.5.5", "^0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0")


# Hyphen ranges

class TestHyphenRanges:
    """Test hyphen (-) ranges."""

    def test_hyphen_full_versions(self):
        """Test hyphen range with full versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("2.3.5", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_partial_left(self):
        """Test hyphen range with partial left side."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_partial_right(self):
        """Test hyphen range with partial right side."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")

    def test_hyphen_partial_right_major_only(self):
        """Test hyphen range with partial right side (major only)."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.5.6", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")


# Comparator sets (AND logic)

class TestComparatorSets:
    """Test multiple comparators in a set (AND logic)."""

    def test_multiple_comparators_both_match(self):
        """Test that version must match all comparators."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_multiple_comparators_first_fails(self):
        """Test that version fails if first comparator fails."""
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_multiple_comparators_second_fails(self):
        """Test that version fails if second comparator fails."""
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_three_comparators(self):
        """Test with three comparators."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0 !=1.5.5")
        assert not satisfies("1.5.5", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0 !=1.5.5")

    def test_range_with_tilde_and_gt(self):
        """Test tilde range combined with other comparators."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2.0 >1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "~1.2.0 >1.2.3")


# Multiple sets (OR logic)

class TestUnion:
    """Test multiple comparator sets (OR logic with ||)."""

    def test_union_first_set_matches(self):
        """Test that version matches if first set matches."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x || 2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x || 2.x")

    def test_union_second_set_matches(self):
        """Test that version matches if second set matches."""
        assert satisfies("2.5.0", "1.x || 2.x")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x || 2.x")

    def test_union_no_set_matches(self):
        """Test that version fails if no set matches."""
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || 2.x")

    def test_union_multiple_sets(self):
        """Test union with more than two sets."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "0.x || 1.x || 2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "0.x || 1.x || 2.x")
        assert satisfies("2.5.0", "0.x || 1.x || 2.x")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "0.x || 1.x || 2.x")

    def test_existing_union_test(self):
        """Test from existing test suite."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")


# Prerelease matching rules

class TestPreleaseMatching:
    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_no_match_without_prerelease_in_set(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match wildcard or non-prerelease comparators."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">=0.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_prerelease_in_set(self):
        """Test that prerelease matches if set has prerelease with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">=1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_matches_gt_prerelease(self):
        """Test prerelease matching with > and prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.10", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_different_major_no_match(self):
        """Test that prerelease of different version doesn't match."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_matches_exact(self):
        """Test prerelease exact match."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-beta")

    def test_prerelease_matches_lte_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test prerelease with <= and prerelease in range."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<=1.0.0-delta")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-delta", "<=1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_matches_caret_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test prerelease with caret range that has prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "^1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_different_patch(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match comparator with different patch."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.1-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_matches_range_with_implicit_prerelease(self):
        """Test that prerelease matches ranges that expand to -0 bounds."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0-alpha", "1.2")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_range_without_prerelease(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match range without prerelease in its comparators."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0-alpha", "1.1 || 1.3")


# Error handling for invalid ranges

class TestInvalidRanges:
    """Test error handling for invalid ranges."""

    def test_invalid_range_double_gt(self):
        """Test that >>1.2.3 raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", ">>1.2.3")

    def test_invalid_range_bad_version(self):
        """Test that invalid version in range raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3.4")

    def test_invalid_range_non_numeric(self):
        """Test that non-numeric range raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", "abc")

    def test_invalid_range_bad_operator(self):
        """Test that invalid operator raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", "~>1.2.3")

    def test_invalid_hyphen_no_right_space(self):
        """Test that hyphen range without right space raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3 -2.3.4")

    def test_invalid_hyphen_no_left_space(self):
        """Test that hyphen range without left space raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3- 2.3.4")


# Edge cases

class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and boundary conditions."""

        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("0.0.1", ">0.0.0")

    def test_large_numbers(self):
        """Test with large version numbers."""
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "100.200.300")
        assert satisfies("100.200.301", ">=100.200.300")

    def test_long_prerelease(self):
        """Test with long prerelease identifiers."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.beta.gamma.1.2.3", "1.0.0-alpha.beta.gamma.1.2.3")

    def test_mixed_case_prerelease(self):
        """Test that prerelease identifiers preserve case."""

        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=  1.0.0  <  2.0.0")

        """Test distinction between exact match and caret."""

    def test_tilde_vs_caret_zero(self):

import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


# ===== Version Validation Tests =====

class TestVersionValidation:
    """Test that invalid versions raise ValueError."""

    def test_valid_exact_versions(self):
        """Valid exact versions should not raise."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "100.200.300")

    def test_valid_versions_with_v_prefix(self):
        """Leading v is allowed."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_valid_versions_with_whitespace(self):
        """Surrounding whitespace is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  1.2.3  ")
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "  1.2.3  ")

    def test_valid_versions_with_build_metadata(self):
        """Build metadata should be ignored in comparison."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build.123", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3+build.456")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+abc", "1.2.3+xyz")

    def test_valid_versions_with_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease versions are valid."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-0.3.7", "1.0.0-0.3.7")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-x.7.z.92", "1.0.0-x.7.z.92")

    def test_valid_versions_with_prerelease_and_build(self):
        """Prerelease and build metadata together are valid."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha+build", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha+build.123", "1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_patch(self):
        """Version without all three numbers should raise."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH should raise."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_prerelease_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros in numeric prerelease identifiers should raise."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.01", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01.2", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_empty_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease cannot be empty."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_too_many_parts(self):
        """Version with extra parts should raise."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4.5", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric_major(self):
        """Non-numeric MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH should raise."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.b.c", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.b.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_negative_numbers(self):
        """Negative numbers should raise."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("-1.2.3", "*")


# ===== Version Ordering Tests =====

class TestVersionOrdering:
    """Test version comparison logic per SemVer spec."""

    def test_major_version_ordering(self):
        """Versions ordered by MAJOR numerically."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.1", "<1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.0.0")

    def test_minor_version_ordering(self):
        """Versions with same MAJOR ordered by MINOR numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.1.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">1.4.0")

    def test_patch_version_ordering(self):
        """Versions with same MAJOR.MINOR ordered by PATCH numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2.1")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">1.2.4")

    def test_prerelease_less_than_release(self):
        """Prerelease version < same version without prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0-rc.1", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_numeric_comparison(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-2")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-10", ">1.0.0-9")

    def test_prerelease_alphanumeric_comparison(self):
        """Non-numeric prerelease identifiers compared in ASCII order."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-beta")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_numeric_less_than_alphanumeric(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifier < non-numeric one."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", ">1.0.0-1")

    def test_prerelease_fewer_identifiers_less(self):
        """Fewer prerelease identifiers < more with same prefix."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1.2", ">1.0.0-1")

    def test_prerelease_different_prefix(self):
        """Different prerelease prefixes compared by identifier."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "<1.0.0-beta.1")

class TestPrimitiveComparators:
    """Test primitive comparators: <, <=, >, >=."""

    def test_less_than(self):
        """< operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "<1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", "<1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "<1.2.3")

    def test_less_than_or_equal(self):
        """<= operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "<=1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "<=1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "<=1.2.3")

    def test_greater_than(self):
        """> operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", ">1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", ">1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", ">1.2.3")

    def test_greater_than_or_equal(self):
        """>= operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", ">=1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">=1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", ">=1.2.3")

    def test_operators_with_whitespace(self):
        """Operators can have whitespace after them."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "> 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">= 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "< 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "<= 1.2.3")

class TestXRanges:
    """Test x-ranges and partial versions."""

    def test_wildcard_star_matches_any(self):
        """* matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "*")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "*")

    def test_wildcard_x_matches_any(self):
        """x matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "x")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "x")

    def test_wildcard_X_matches_any(self):
        """X matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "X")

    def test_empty_range_matches_any(self):
        """Empty range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "")

    def test_partial_major_x(self):
        """1.x is 1.0.0 to <2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "1.x")

    def test_partial_major_only(self):
        """1 is 1.0.0 to <2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")

    def test_partial_major_minor_x(self):
        """1.2.x is 1.2.0 to <1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.999", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2.x")

    def test_partial_major_minor_only(self):
        """1.2 is 1.2.0 to <1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")

    def test_partial_with_operator_gt_major_x(self):
        """>1 expands to >=2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1")
        assert satisfies("2.1.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1")

    def test_partial_with_operator_gt_major_minor(self):
        """>1.2 expands to >=1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.4.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.9", ">1.2")

    def test_partial_with_operator_gte_major_minor(self):
        """>=1.2 expands to >=1.2.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">=1.2")

    def test_partial_with_operator_lt_major_minor(self):
        """<1.2 expands to <1.2.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0-alpha", "<1.2")

    def test_partial_with_operator_lte_major_minor(self):
        """<=1.2 expands to <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")

    def test_partial_with_operator_lte_major(self):
        """<=1 expands to <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<=1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1")

    def test_partial_with_operator_gt_star(self):
        """>* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", ">*")

    def test_partial_with_operator_lt_star(self):
        """<* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", "<*")

# ===== Prerelease Tests =====

class TestPreleaseMatching:
    """Test prerelease matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_matches_set_with_same_prerelease_comparator(self):
        """Prerelease version matches set if set has prerelease with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", ">1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta", ">1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_no_prerelease_comparator(self):
        """Prerelease version doesn't match set without prerelease comparator of same M.m.p."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_explicit_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease version matches exact prerelease comparator."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta")

    def test_prerelease_matches_hyphen_range_with_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease in hyphen range if bound has prerelease."""
        # 1.0.0-alpha - 2.0.0: left has prerelease with 1.0.0, so matches 1.0.0-beta
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha - 2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_different_mmp_no_match(self):
        """Prerelease of different M.m.p doesn't match."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha", ">1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_matches_lt_bound_with_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches < bound with -0 (from x-ranges)."""
        # <1.3.0-0 from ~1.2.3 should match 1.2.3-alpha
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "~1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_gt_bound_no_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease doesn't match > 1.2.3 without prerelease."""
        # This should not match because no comparator has 1.2.4 with prerelease
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4-alpha", ">1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_matches_gte_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches >= prerelease of same M.m.p."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.5", ">=1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_prerelease_multiple_sets_first_matches(self):
        """Prerelease in union: matches if at least one set has prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta || 2.x")


# ===== Edge Cases and Error Handling =====

class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and special scenarios."""

    def test_leading_v_in_range(self):
        """Leading v in range version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">=v1.2.0")

    def test_whitespace_in_range(self):
        """Whitespace handling in ranges."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  1.2.3  ")

    def test_zero_versions(self):
        """0.0.0 version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("0.0.1", ">0.0.0")

    def test_large_version_numbers(self):
        """Large version numbers."""
        assert satisfies("999.888.777", "999.888.777")
        assert satisfies("999.888.777", ">999.888.776")

    def test_complex_prerelease_identifiers(self):
        """Complex prerelease with many identifiers."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-x.7.z.92", "1.0.0-x.7.z.92")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-x.7.z.93", ">1.0.0-x.7.z.92")

    def test_build_metadata_ignored_in_ranges(self):
        """Build metadata ignored across all range types."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+abc", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+xyz", "1.2.3+abc")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4+build", "^1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_with_build_metadata(self):
        """Prerelease with build metadata."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha+001", "1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_invalid_range_syntax(self):
        """Invalid range syntax raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", ">>1.2.3")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3.4")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "abc")

class TestIntegration:
    """Integration tests combining multiple features."""

    def test_caret_with_multiple_constraints(self):
        """Caret range with multiple constraints."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.2.3 <1.6.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.6.0", "^1.2.3 <1.6.0")

    def test_tilde_with_union(self):
        """Tilde ranges in union."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2.0 || ~2.1.0")
        assert satisfies("2.1.3", "~1.2.0 || ~2.1.0")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "~1.2.0 || ~2.1.0")

    def test_hyphen_with_prerelease(self):
        """Hyphen range including prerelease bounds."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha - 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha - 1.0.0")

    def test_multiple_union_sets_with_ranges(self):
        """Union of different range types."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "~1.0.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.5.0")
        assert satisfies("2.3.0", "~1.0.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.5.0")
        assert satisfies("4.0.0", "~1.0.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.5.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0-alpha", "~1.0.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.5.0")

    def test_strict_version_comparison(self):
        """Strict numeric comparison despite digit counts."""
        assert satisfies("1.10.0", ">1.9.0")
        assert satisfies("1.10.0", ">1.2.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1.10.0")
